note: The prepared root was prepared from a curation tree with no UMU provider TOML; the build's curation tree has one. The build must not resolve against the stale prepared copy of the authored sources.
fails_if: the build stops calling `check_authored_sources` after opening the prepared root (an authored-source edit after `prepare-sources` then builds silently from the stale prepared records), or the guard compares only the authored sources the prepared root pins as present
